title: Lower and Upper Lie Nilpotency Indices of Modular Group Algebras
summary: We resolve the remaining cases of a longstanding problem on the lower and upper Lie nilpotency indices of modular group algebras. Equality of the two indices has been known in characteristics greater than three since 1992; we establish it in the remaining characteristics two and three, thereby completing the problem for finite groups of prime-power order over finite fields.
